text:
The energy generated in stable stars comes from nuclear reactions.
Which type of reaction occurs in the Sun?
A
Helium nuclei break up to give hydrogen nuclei.
B
Helium nuclei join together to form hydrogen nuclei.
C
Hydrogen nuclei break up to give helium nuclei.
D
Hydrogen nuclei join together to form helium nuclei.

options.label: A
options.text: Helium nuclei break up to give hydrogen nuclei.

options.text: Helium nuclei join together to form hydrogen nuclei.
